title: Conditions to check for Maximum Upload Size

question.author: member_229
question.body: Could support clarify maximum upload size in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: Uploads that exceed the limit fail with the error "File too large". You can upload files up to 20 GB in size through the desktop and mobile clients, and through the API. The web app has a separate, smaller limit: files uploaded through a browser are capped at 2 GB. If a web upload fails near 2 GB, switch to the desktop client — this is expected behavior, not a bug. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
